authority_note: Factual/evidentiary predicates only. Public Product owns reader wording; Release Integrity owns machine packaging.

facility_predicate_definitions.CONTINUED_PRESENCE_NO_SHUTDOWN_REPORTED: Presence or continuity is reported, but operation is not affirmatively established merely from presence.
facility_predicate_definitions.DAMAGED_BUT_OPERATING: Physical damage plus affirmative evidence of continued operation at the represented facility/system scope.
facility_predicate_definitions.DAMAGED_NOT_OPERATING: Physical damage plus affirmative evidence the represented facility/node is not operating.
facility_predicate_definitions.DAMAGED_OPERATIONAL_EFFECT_UNKNOWN: Physical damage established; current operation/shutdown not established.
facility_predicate_definitions.DESTROYED: Facility or represented node is physically destroyed; later operation requires separate reconstitution evidence.
facility_predicate_definitions.OPERATIONAL_CONTINUITY_ESTABLISHED: Affirmative evidence of operating activity exists.
facility_predicate_definitions.WITHDRAWN_CLOSED_TRANSFERRED: Administrative withdrawal, closure, relocation or transfer is established; not a destruction predicate.

facilities.basis: CAOC reported inoperable; campaign command shifted to Shaw. Whole-base incapacity is not established.
Generator hit and one reactor automatically shut down; current restart status unresolved; no whole-plant destruction.
Terminal damage and disruption established; Terminal 4 flight continuity reported.
IAEA reported severe damage and facility no longer operational; repair/restart unresolved.
Remaining system operates; two of 14 LNG trains and a GTL facility remained unavailable by Sep. 11; approximately 12.8 mtpa affected and multi-year repair effect reported.
HQ function relocated to MacDill after extensive damage; evidence does not establish cessation of every local NSA Bahrain function.
Damage verified; U.S. troops later reported present; presence is not silently upgraded to operational status.
Substantial localized damage verified; no affirmative whole-base shutdown or current full-operation record in the evidence predicate.
Power plant and other damage verified; no whole-site shutdown established.
The specific TOC was destroyed; this does not establish destruction of Camp Arifjan or the regional network.
U.S. troop position reported; Iranian attack/damage claim not independently corroborated; operational effect unknown.
Reported relocated position; permanence and operational effect not established.
Damage verified and U.S. presence established; absence of a whole-base shutdown report is not affirmative proof of full operation.
Port-area damage/fire established; no isolated destroyed U.S. naval asset or whole-access-site shutdown established.
Military/airport area damage reported while broader Iraq drawdown was underway; do not treat as stable permanent-base operational status.
U.S. forces fully withdrew by Jan. 17, 2026; not an active U.S. base for the war baseline.
Aircraft/base damage verified and later U.S. presence reported; no whole-base shutdown established.
Earlier THAAD damage plus Sep. 8 aircraft damage are established; exact BDA and whole-base operational effect remain unresolved.
Operational U.S. wing activity publicly documented; no reviewed damage report.
Patriot/base damage established; no whole-site shutdown established.
Retained during February drawdown reporting, but later current presence not refreshed; cannot label current operation from stale presence alone.
Withdrawal began during February 2026 drawdown; current operating presence not established.
U.S. withdrawal completed Feb. 12, 2026; not an active U.S. garrison afterward absent re-entry evidence.

lie_knowledge_predicates.constraint: LIKELY_KNEW_FALSE, VERY_LIKELY_KNEW_FALSE, POSSIBLE_KNOWLEDGE, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and NOT_ASSESSABLE are not equivalent to knowing falsehood established. Their public factual labels must remain False/Misleading/Partly true/Unresolved as supported, without 'Lie' unless knowledge is separately established.

current_public_ready_lie_findings.basis: The same Press TV article used the weaker 'target around 210' wording in its body while publishing a headline that said Iran had 'downed' about 210 aircraft. The publisher therefore possessed the contrary/weaker wording in the article it published; the finding applies to publisher framing, not automatically to every quoted Iranian official.

lie_knowledge_predicates.jordan_heavy_damage_update: Later evidence establishes real U.S. aircraft damage at Muwaffaq Salti. The earlier broad Iranian 'heavy damage' proposition therefore cannot remain a simple no-damage falsity; the supported boundary is real damage established, scope/severity claim only partly substantiated/overstated, knowledge of any overstatement not established.
lie_knowledge_predicates.rule: Factual falsity and claimant knowledge are separate. 'Lie' is permitted only where evidence supports knowledge of falsity at statement time or an institutionally attributable knowledge chain.

material_loss_predicates.public_product_boundary: No honest all-platform or all-actor 'total losses' number exists across the present record. Class-specific exact/minimum totals are permissible only from the compatible subset.

quantity_classes.CLAIM_ONLY_QUANTITY: Actor target/loss claim not verified; excluded from physical aggregate.
quantity_classes.KNOWN_PHYSICAL_QUANTITY: Exact sourced integer for an identified physical asset/set; may be summed after stable-ID deduplication.
quantity_classes.MINIMUM_CONFIRMED_QUANTITY: Use only when the source itself establishes a lower bound (for example 'at least N'); do not infer a minimum from vague plural language.
quantity_classes.NONDEFENSIBLE_NUMERIC: Approximate or mixed-category report that cannot be converted to an exact quantity.
quantity_classes.UNKNOWN_QUANTITY: Physical damage/loss established but quantity null.

material_loss_predicates.rule: Atlas may sum only stable physical asset records with defensible numeric quantity and compatible asset class/status. Claim-only target counts, null quantities, approximate quantities and mixed unresolved classes stay outside the numeric total.

objective_predicates.basis: No Iranian nuclear weapon is established, but no durable controlling nuclear settlement exists and the IAEA safeguards dispute has escalated to Security Council referral.
Substantial attrition/degradation is established, but Iran retains and uses missiles, drones and maritime coercive capability.

objective_predicates.objective: Reduce Iran's ability to arm and sustain proxies
objective_predicates.basis: Some proxy/network degradation is established, but the Houthi force remains operationally capable and made major Sep. 10-11 territorial gains.
Physical transit exists, but observable traffic remains severely depressed, attacks continue and no normalized navigation regime controls.

objective_predicates.objective: Use economic isolation to narrow Tehran's options
objective_predicates.basis: Severe trade/export/financial pressure and expanding sanctions are established; Iran remains capable of trade and coercive action and is not fully isolated.

objective_predicates.objective: U.S. withdrawal from bases surrounding Iran
objective_predicates.basis: Some unrelated/preexisting drawdowns occurred, but the broad demanded regional withdrawal is not established.
No durable non-aggression/protection guarantee exists; aligned actors remain exposed to attack.

objective_predicates.objective: Permanent Iranian Hormuz sovereignty / management / fees
objective_predicates.basis: Iran has coercive leverage, but recognized exclusive sovereignty/management and compulsory fee rights are not established; Iran also temporarily suspended an energy freight charge.

objective_predicates.objective: No concessions on nuclear, missiles, defense or regional architecture
objective_predicates.basis: Important capabilities/red lines remain, but the record already includes mediated/shared maritime arrangements inconsistent with the earlier categorical all-or-nothing posture; final nuclear/missile bargain remains unresolved.

shipping_predicates.baseline_rule: Use the same Kpler/provider series for short-term comparison. The approximately 125 large commercial vessels/day prewar figure is contextual scale only, not a mathematically compatible denominator for Kpler's narrower observable series.

weapons_effect_predicates.aggregation_rule: Aggregate only where source, time window, weapon class, denominator definition and stage semantics are identical.

permitted_chains.constraint: The later damage means the early impact account and BDA require reconciliation; do not infer a clean 18/20 interception-to-zero-hit chain.
permitted_chains.damage: Later U.S.-sourced reporting establishes real U.S. aircraft damage
permitted_chains.penetration_or_fall: Jordan initially reported two fell in unpopulated areas

weapons_effect_predicates.reason: Launch/expenditure, interception, penetration, impact and damage observations come from different incidents, providers, time windows and counting universes. They cannot be divided into a whole-war effectiveness percentage.
